reason: I'll start with the chassis so the racer can roll.
expectation: The bearing tubes should fit onto the chassis and support the wheel axles, though I don't yet know the exact fitting.

alternatives.reason: Making the sail also seems useful, but I want to build the rolling base first.

effect: The chassis now has bearings, so I can add the wheels.
reaction: A straightforward first fitting; I'm curious how the racer will move.
reason: Adding the wheels should finish the rolling base.
expectation: The captive axles will fit into the bearings, leaving a chassis that can roll.

alternatives.reason: The sail is also needed, but I'd rather complete the base first.

effect: The wheeled chassis is ready, so the sail is the next construction.
reaction: The rolling base came together predictably.
reason: The sail is the only offered combination and should provide a way for wind to push the racer.
expectation: The sailcloth will attach to the mast and crossbar to make a sail assembly.

effect: The sail is ready, and its broad surface should turn wind into a push on the wheeled chassis.
reaction: The explanation makes the wind racer's mechanism clear.
reason: Attach the sail to the rolling base; it's the only offered combination.
expectation: The mast will fit onto the chassis to make a wind racer, though it may still need a launch.

effect: The sail and chassis are assembled into a racer, and the pinwheel is the only offered next fitting.
reaction: I'm curious what role the pinwheel will play on the racer.
reason: I'll add the pinwheel to the racer; it's the only offered combination.
expectation: The pinwheel will attach to the racer, perhaps as a spinning decoration, though its purpose is unclear.

effect: The pinwheel is a wind-direction indicator, not a fitting; the racer is now oriented for launch.
reaction: That was a satisfying and useful reuse of the pinwheel.
reason: The starting gate is the only offered combination and should prepare the racer for its run.
expectation: The gate will release the racer down the lane, though I don't know if another step will be needed.

effect: The starting gate released the completed racer, which reached the watering can and fulfilled the goal.
reaction: The successful run and Kit's interest made the construction feel worthwhile.

mostWorthwhile.text: Using the pinwheel to find the breeze's direction was the most worthwhile moment: it gave the earlier toy a practical role and clarified how to position the racer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the bearing tubes and wheels was predictable, though it established how the rolling base was built.

surprise.text: I expected the pinwheel to attach to the racer, but it stayed in hand as a wind-direction indicator.

arbitrary.text: The pinwheel's purpose was unclear before I used it, but the result explained it; no action ultimately felt arbitrary.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the wind-direction reuse and the successful run made me curious what the fair might do next.
